sharedSettingsPipeline.reader: $kn -> uAn keyed by descriptor.key -> VK data.values[key] ?? descriptor.default
sharedSettingsPipeline.query: VK: host settings.readAll when available, otherwise get-settings; networkMode always, placeholder sAn, five-second staleTime.
sharedSettingsPipeline.writer: rAn snapshots VK, starts cancel, captures old data, optimistically patches by default, awaits cancel, then awaits oAn; write error restores the entire old snapshot; finally awaits invalidate then calls GG.
sharedSettingsPipeline.nonOptimisticOption: optimistic:false patches the current cache only after successful write, preserving concurrent unrelated keys in that snapshot.
sharedSettingsPipeline.conditionalProviderErrors: cancel is awaited before try and invalidate before GG; injected cancel rejection bypasses write/rollback/finally, and injected invalidate rejection skips GG. Real provider failure behavior is not established by this probe.
sharedSettingsPipeline.hostOrFallback: oAn: e6.settings.write(key,value) when available; otherwise generic set-setting params {key,value}. aAn reads effective directly from host, or fallback response.value ?? default.
sharedSettingsPipeline.mainFallback: Selected get/set-setting handlers use getSettingValue/setSettingValue. The setter validates/casts through r.F then awaits this.settings.write. Initialization wraps injected T in AL and invokes afterWrite side effects.
sharedSettingsPipeline.durabilityBoundary: AL.write calls store.set and afterWrite without explicitly awaiting store.flush. AL.writeForAgent enforces descriptor.agentAccess and explicitly flushes. Backing store instance, file path, schedule, durability and actual host-to-main identity remain unobserved.
sharedSettingsPipeline.uiVersusAgentAccess: agentAccess read-only does not disable these UI controls; it is enforced by writeForAgent, a separate path.
sharedSettingsPipeline.scopeQualification: Static selected source paths and synthetic provider replay; no real preferences, filesystem store, service, native host or product run.

autosave.draft: A snapshot object records each edit. Reverting to savedValue clears dirty only when no mutation is pending; editing remains allowed while pending.
autosave.automatic: Timer and unmount flush submit only a draft snapshot distinct from last-submitted and last-failed; there is no automatic isPending check. Mutation serialization belongs to the imported provider.
autosave.explicit: Save and CmdOrCtrl+S require draft and !isPending, clear the failed snapshot and submit. The textarea has no blur-save handler and no explicit cancel action.
autosave.success: Clear only the submitted snapshot, preserve newer edits, show saved feedback, call onSaved with the submitted value even when a newer draft exists.
autosave.failure: Retain draft and mark failed snapshot, show danger toast, suppress automatic/unmount retry of that snapshot; explicit save or a new edit permits another attempt.
autosave.runtimeQualification: Hook lifecycle, timer, pending state and mutation delivery are substitutes; no React or query/mutation implementation is executed.

activeWatcherUpdate.trigger: De schedules a separate scoped mutation after a preference save, using the submitted value plus the peer preference captured by the current callback.
activeWatcherUpdate.selection: v lists automations; F9n/gM require heartbeat and the exact ## Pull request fix automation: prompt line, status ACTIVE, and the heartbeat continuation marker line D. Other records are skipped.
activeWatcherUpdate.transformation: Preserve all prompt lines through marker D, rebuild following lines using C(prefs), trim custom instructions, skip an unchanged prompt.
activeWatcherUpdate.effect: b calls automation-update for existing items; response must satisfy the original heartbeat kind predicate. Promise.all updates are concurrent; the page invalidates list-automations only after the updater resolves.
activeWatcherUpdate.failures: Errors propagate to a separate active-watcher error toast. Preference-save success can already have been reported. No compensation of saved preferences or successful sibling watcher updates is present in this selected path.
